Tried to define class: org/springframework/context/annotation/aspectj/SpringConfiguredConfiguration$$SpringCGLIB$$0. SpringConfiguredConfiguration (in spring-aspects itself) is a plain @Configuration (proxyBeanMethods=true by default) auto-imported by @EnableSpringConfigured, and Spring CGLIB-enhances it at runtime for @Bean method interception. This is the exact same class of failure already fixed for org.springframework:spring-context:6.0.0 and org.springframework:spring-aop:6.0.0 in this repo — mirror that pattern for spring-aspects: (1) add system property spring.objenesis.ignore=true to `tasks.withType(Test).configureEach`, to `nativeTest` runtimeArgs, and to `graalvmNative.binaries.test.buildArgs`; (2) add a `generatePredefinedCglibProxyClasses` JavaExec task (see PredefinedCglibProxyClassesGenerator.java under tests/src/org.springframework/spring-context/6.0.0/src/test/java and tests/src/org.springframework/spring-aop/6.0.0/src/test/java) that forks a JVM with `-Dcglib.debugLocation=<compiled test classes dir>` and `-Dspring.objenesis.ignore=true`, exercises the code path that triggers the CGLIB enhancement (e.g. instantiate the @EnableSpringConfigured config, as in the existing springConfiguredRegistersTheSingletonBeanConfigurerAspect test) so SpringConfiguredConfiguration$$SpringCGLIB$$0.class is dumped onto the compiled test-classes directory, then verify that expected class file exists; (3) make `nativeTestCompile` and `nativeTraceImage` depend on that task. input_evidence.summary: #9399 [Automation] native-image run fails for org.springframework:spring-aspects:6.0.0; label=fails-native-image-run; body_chars=8015

risks: The predefinition workaround relies on CGLIB's debug-location dump landing exactly on the native-image build classpath before analysis; if class naming/hashing changes in a later spring-aspects/spring-core patch, the generator's expected-class-file check will need updating.

Only the AdviceMode.ASPECTJ-based aspects and the @EnableSpringConfigured path were verified; any newly added test exercising proxy-based (CGLIB) advice modes would need the same predefinition treatment or it will hit the identical runtime-class-definition error.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: spring-aspects 6.0.0's @EnableSpringConfigured imports SpringConfiguredConfiguration, a @Configuration bean CGLIB-enhances at runtime; Native Image rejects that runtime class definition unless the proxy class is pre-generated onto the test classpath, the same fix already applied for spring-context/6.0.0 and spring-aop/6.0.0 in this repo.
